description:
# Master compliance for opi-q5k.5

Source check: opi-q5k.5 (editor.test.ts audit)

Upstream `tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts` has 173 tests across 13 describes. Our Input absorbed upstream Editor features; this epic audits and ports the remaining gaps per describe area. Each child is independent and blocks opi-q5k.1 (the parent audit epic's acceptance gate).

## Children

One ticket per upstream describe area. Processing workflow:

1. Read the specific describe block in editor.test.ts.
2. Enumerate every `it(...)` in that describe.
3. Locate matching Elixir assertions in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (and related test files if relevant).
4. Implement any unmapped behavior + add the missing tests.
5. Re-compare upstream vs Elixir and close the child.

The "Backslash+Enter newline workaround" describe is a documented divergence — its child ticket should codify the divergence in a moduledoc / AGENTS note and close without porting.

## Deps
- This ticket blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).
- All children block this ticket.
title: Port editor.test.ts gaps (master — 13 describe areas)
